title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Cancellation Terms Schedule
content:
Cancellation and refund terms of Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts, by coverage level.

| Coverage level | Free-look days after the sale date | Unused share measured by | Cancellation fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | 30 | lesser of time and mileage | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | 30 | lesser of time and mileage | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Select | 60 | lesser of time and mileage | 75.00 |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | 60 | lesser of time and mileage | 50.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | 60 | lesser of time and mileage | 50.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | 60 | time alone | 50.00 |

**Terms common to every level.**

| Term | Every coverage level |
|---|---|
| No cancellation fee when the vehicle is a total loss | yes |
| Claims paid deducted from a pro-rata refund | no |
| Contract sold on a purchase deal that is unwound cancelled flat with a full refund | yes |
| Refund on a contract financed on the installment contract paid to the lienholder | yes |
| Calendar days after the cancellation is processed within which the refund is paid | 30 |

**Measures.** "Lesser of time and mileage" means the unused share is the smaller of the unused time share and the unused mileage share. "Time alone" means only the unused time share is used. The free-look days count calendar days after the contract's sale date.
